label: Allowed source directory
help: Required. Relative file paths are resolved here; files outside this directory and symbolic links are refused.

label: Maximum audio duration (s)
help: A longer file is rejected completely, never silently truncated.

label: Pending files
help: One file streams at a time. Additional files wait in this bounded queue; overflow is reported.

label: Maximum source size (MiB)
help: Bounds the private source snapshot. Source files are never modified.

label: Preparation timeout (s)
help: Deadline for copying, validation and local FFmpeg conversion before streaming begins.

label: WAV conversion bitrate (kb/s)
help: PCM16 WAV is converted to 48 kHz Opus. Existing Ogg/Opus packets are remuxed without re-encoding.
